statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-14524: when an HTTP(S) transfer that uses an OAuth2 bearer token follows a redirect to an IMAP, LDAP, POP3 or SMTP URL, curl could send the bearer token to the new host (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2025-14524.html). curl fixed it in 8.18.0 with commit https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/1a822275d333dc6da6043497160fd04c8fa48640. Alpine lists it under 8.18.0-r0 in the 3.23-stable main/curl APKBUILD secfixes (https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/curl/APKBUILD). The DHI curl package for Alpine 3.23 builds the upstream curl release; its earliest published build, 8.17.0-r1, is curl 8.17.0, which is affected, and 8.18.0-r0 and every later build are curl 8.18.0 or newer, which carry the fix. The libcurl library in the 8.17.0-r1 and 8.18.0-r0 packages for x86_64 and aarch64 reports libcurl/8.17.0 and libcurl/8.18.0 respectively. The range ends at 8.18.0-r0.

CVE-2025-14524: when an HTTP(S) transfer that uses an OAuth2 bearer token follows a redirect to an IMAP, LDAP, POP3 or SMTP URL, curl could send the bearer token to the new host (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2025-14524.html). curl fixed it in 8.18.0 with commit https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/1a822275d333dc6da6043497160fd04c8fa48640, and Debian backported the fix to trixie in 8.14.1-2+deb13u4 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-14524). The DHI curl package for Debian 13 is built from Debian's trixie source. Its published builds are based on Debian's 8.14.1-2+deb13u5 and 8.14.1-2+deb13u7, and the shipped package changelog of each, for amd64 and arm64, contains Debian's 8.14.1-2+deb13u4 entry importing the upstream patch for CVE-2025-14524. Earlier builds, based on Debian's 8.14.1-2+deb13u2 and 8.14.1-2+deb13u3, are no longer published and sort below this range's end. The range ends at the first published build that carries it.
